Appendix table 11. Number of prisoners in the custody of state and federal correctional authorities, by sex, 2010–2015
Note: Custody does not include prisoners held in private facilities, local jails, or other state prisons.

a/As of December 31, 2001, sentenced felons from the District of Columbia were the responsibility of the Federal Bureau of Prisons; therefore, specific counts for the District of Columbia are not included in this table.
